advancements.assortedkitchen.butter.desc: Work a butter churn until it gives up its butter
advancements.assortedkitchen.cheese.desc: Turn a bucket of milk into a block of cheese
advancements.assortedkitchen.chocolate.d: Set hot chocolate into a bar
advancements.assortedkitchen.pie.title: Easy As Pie
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.chocolate: Hot chocolate rolled into balls is the quickest thing here to eat, and what the cake is built from.
A plain bar is food on its own, and the base of everything wrapped.
Cocoa dust and milk in a bowl is cold chocolate, which is not much use on its own. Any milk bucket will do, including the ones Assorted Tools adds.
Chocolate balls and milk make a cake. It is placed and eaten a slice at a time, the way any cake is.
Ground down in a mortar and pestle, cocoa beans give cocoa dust.
Heat the bowl in a furnace and it becomes hot chocolate. Everything below wants it hot.

Place the mold and right click it with hot chocolate to pour.

It steams while it sets, and every block of ice or snow packed against its sides cools it faster.

Once it has set, right click the mold for the bars.
One bowl of hot chocolate sets into two bars.
The mortar and pestle grinds cocoa beans. It stays in the crafting grid and wears out a little with every use.
Nine bars press into a block, and a block gives the nine back.
Make a wrapper, wrap a bar in it, and the result feeds you better than the bare bar did.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.dairy.but:
Right click the churn with any milk bucket to fill it. It separates on its own, but every right click while it works gives the handle a turn and hurries it along.

Right click once more when it is done for two butter.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.dairy.che: A block of cheese cuts into nine pieces, and nine pieces press back into a block.

The cheese maker takes a milk bucket the same way, but it needs longer and cannot be hurried. Watch it turn from pale to a yellow orange.

When it has gone the whole way, right click it to get your cheese.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.dairy.hot: Melted cheese is the filling a burger wants, and better food than the cold piece was.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.dairy.mak: Any milk bucket should work to craft these wonderful Dairy items. So don't worry about it.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.food.eggs:
Crack eggs into a bowl with some butter, mix them, then cook them in a furnace. Raw eggs are not worth eating, and the game will let you try anyway.

Cooked eggs are filling and heal well, which is most of the reason to keep butter around.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.food.knif: The knife slices bread and pumpkins. It stays in the crafting grid and wears out a little with every cut.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.food.sand: Bread cuts into slices, and slices with cheese make a burger that carries a long trip.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.food.whis: The whisk beats eggs, and wears out the same way the knife does.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.pies.baki: A raw pie bakes in a furnace, and the baked pie is a block. Place it down and eat it a slice at a time, the way a cake works.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.pies.choc: Chocolate balls fill a pie too, and it bakes the same way.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.pies.ingr: Every pie starts with dough in a pan. Pumpkin slices are the one filling you have to cut yourself.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.pies.raw: Make an empty pie, then fill it with apple, pumpkin, melon or pork. A raw pie is not food yet.
manual.assortedcuisine.description: Cocoa, chocolate, dairy and everything else this mod gives you to cook, bottle and eat.
